mapper.insert: insert into knowledge_chunks ( document_id, chunk_index, content, char_count, token_count ) values ( #{documentId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{content}, #{charCount}, #{tokenCount} )
mapper.select:
select chunk.id as chunk_id, document.id as document_id, document.title, document.category, document.source_department, document.source_url, document.published_at, chunk.content, match(chunk.content) against( #{keyword} in natural language mode ) as score
from knowledge_chunks chunk
inner join knowledge_documents document on document.id = chunk.document_id
where document.school_id = #{schoolId}
and document.status = 'PUBLISHED'
and ( document.effective_at is null or document.effective_at <= current_timestamp )
and ( document.expires_at is null or document.expires_at > current_timestamp )
and match(chunk.content) against( #{keyword} in natural language mode )
order by score desc, document.published_at desc, chunk.id asc
limit #{limit}

select chunk.id as chunk_id, document.id as document_id, document.title, document.category, document.source_department, document.source_url, document.published_at, chunk.content, ( case when document.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') then 6 else 0 end
+ case when document.title like concat('%', #{term}, '%') then 2.5 else 0 end + case when chunk.content like concat('%', #{term}, '%') then 1 else 0 end + case when document.category like concat('%', #{term}, '%') then 0.8 else 0 end + case when document.source_department like concat('%', #{term}, '%') then 0.4 else 0 end
) as score
from knowledge_chunks chunk
inner join knowledge_documents document on document.id = chunk.document_id
where document.school_id = #{schoolId}
and document.status = 'PUBLISHED'
and ( document.effective_at is null or document.effective_at <= current_timestamp )
and ( document.expires_at is null or document.expires_at > current_timestamp )
and (
document.title like concat('%', #{term}, '%') or chunk.content like concat('%', #{term}, '%') or document.category like concat('%', #{term}, '%') or document.source_department like concat('%', #{term}, '%')
)
order by score desc, document.published_at desc, chunk.id asc
limit #{limit}
